privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Basic information about how URL to Video handles the data needed to generate videos from public URLs.
privacy.intro: URL to Video is a web tool that lets you submit a public URL to generate an MP4 video. This policy explains, in simple terms, what information we use to provide the service.

data.title: Data we process
data.body: We process the URL you enter, the selected media mode and technical data needed to process the request, such as job identifiers, render status and technical errors if they occur.

purpose.title: How we use the data
purpose.body: We use this information to analyze the submitted URL, generate the script, find visual resources, create the voice, render the MP4 and make it available for download.

sensitive.title: Sensitive data
sensitive.body: We do not ask for passwords, banking information or software installation. You should not submit private URLs, login-protected pages or links containing confidential information.

providers.title: Technical providers
providers.body: The service may rely on external tools for automation, voice generation, visual asset search, rendering and hosting. These tools are used only to provide the requested functionality.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions or data deletion requests, email support@urltovideo.es.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: Basic conditions for using URL to Video responsibly.
terms.intro: By using URL to Video, you accept these basic terms. The tool is designed to convert public URLs into vertical videos for social media.

use.title: Allowed use
use.body: You may use the tool to generate videos from news, blogs, articles or public pages related to your activity.

responsibility.title: User responsibility
responsibility.body: You are responsible for the URLs you submit and for the final use of generated videos. You must respect copyright, privacy, trademarks and the rules of the platforms where you publish the content.

limitations.title: Service limitations
limitations.body: The service may fail, take longer than expected or be unable to process some URLs. We do not guarantee continuous availability or perfect results in every case.

prohibited.title: Prohibited uses
prohibited.body: Do not use the tool to create misleading, fraudulent, illegal, abusive, defamatory content or content that impersonates others.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions or suggestions, email support@urltovideo.es.

srt.question: What is an SRT file and what is it used for?
srt.answer: An SRT is a text file with subtitles and timecodes. It is used to add subtitles to videos in editors, players and platforms.

mp3.question: How can I convert an MP3 to SRT?
mp3.answer: Upload the MP3 file, choose how many words you want per segment and select SRT as the download format.

precision.question: How accurate is the transcription?
precision.answer: Accuracy depends on voice clarity, background noise, language and file quality. Clear spoken audio usually gives better results.

compatibility.question: Does the generated SRT work with CapCut, Premiere or YouTube?
compatibility.answer: Yes. SRT and VTT are common formats for video editors and platforms. CSV is useful if you need to review or reuse segments as data.

formats.question: Which formats can I upload?

segments.question: Can I choose how many words each subtitle has?

paste.title: Paste a public article URL
paste.text: Add the URL of a public article, blog post or news story. If a site blocks crawling, switch to Text mode and paste the article body.

visuals.title: Choose visuals
visuals.text: Select stock footage or AI-generated images depending on the style you want for your article video.

language.title: Select output language
language.text: Choose English or Spanish for the generated voiceover, subtitles and final video narration.

download.title: Generate and download the MP4
download.text: The cloud workflow creates the script, voice, subtitles and vertical MP4 ready for short-form social publishing.

comparison.title: Article to video AI vs manual video editing

tips.title: Tips for better article to video results

publicUrls.title: Use public URLs
publicUrls.text: Public articles without login walls or heavy bot protection are easier to extract and convert into video.

clearIdea.title: Choose articles with a clear main idea
clearIdea.text: Focused articles usually produce better scripts than pages with many unrelated topics or scattered sections.

blockedUrls.title: Paste text when a URL is blocked
blockedUrls.text: If the page has a paywall, captcha or crawler block, switch to Text mode and paste the main article body.

language.title: Use English for global distribution
language.text: Choose English output when publishing to international audiences across TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

pacing.title: Prefer concise articles for short videos
pacing.text: Shorter or well-structured articles tend to produce tighter vertical videos with clearer pacing.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about article to video AI

anyUrl.question: Can I convert any article URL into a video?
anyUrl.answer: You can convert public article URLs that can be accessed by the system. Some sites may block crawling with paywalls, captchas or technical restrictions.

paywall.question: What happens if the article is behind a paywall?
paywall.answer: If the article cannot be crawled, switch to Text mode and paste the article body directly. This keeps the workflow focused on the content instead of the blocked URL.

blogs.question: Can I turn blog posts into videos?
blogs.answer: Yes. Blog posts are a strong fit for article to video AI because they usually have a clear structure, headline and main points.

news.question: Does it work for news articles?
news.answer: Yes. Public news articles can be converted into short narrated updates with subtitles and vertical visuals.

languages.question: Can I generate videos in English and Spanish?
languages.answer: Yes. You can choose English or Spanish as the output language before generating the video.

shorts.question: Are the videos ready for TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts?
shorts.answer: Yes. The output is designed as a vertical 9:16 MP4 for short-form social platforms.

CookieConsent.title: We use cookies to improve the experience.
CookieConsent.description: Essential cookies are always active. If you accept all, we will also enable analytics to understand how the website is used and improve the service.
